title: Project Manager
purpose: Responsible for the day-to-day execution of project delivery. Translates project commitments into actionable plans, coordinates teams, manages schedule and cost, and ensures agreed deliverables are produced on time and within constraints. Operates within information governance standards, ensuring delivery plans reflect information requirements and acceptance milestones.
authority_statements: Manage schedule and cost within approved parameters
Escalate conflicts when delivery constraints cannot be resolved operationally
May approve day-to-day project plans, schedules, and internal milestones
May approve resource allocations within approved budgets
May reject unplanned changes to scope, schedule, or BIM execution that conflict with project plan
May not override enterprise BIM governance and role definitions
May not override formal information management rules owned by BIM Director / BIM Manager
May not override acceptance gates or define BIM standards
responsibilities: Translate client and contractual requirements into a coordinated delivery plan, including BIM elements
Maintain the project schedule and cost, taking into account BIM information dependencies and milestones
Coordinate with Project BIM Manager to ensure BEP, MIDP, and TIDPs are realistic and integrated into project planning
Raise and resolve resource and scope conflicts that affect BIM delivery
Manage daily project execution across scope, schedule, and budget
Ensure that information delivery tasks (coordination, validation, submission) are planned and resourced
Track progress against agreed milestones, including information delivery milestones
Identify risks early and escalate conflicts when delivery and governance cannot align
Maintain alignment between client expectations and actual project readiness
accountabilities: Ensuring information delivery is planned, coordinated, and achievable as part of overall project execution
Ensuring project delivery commitments are met within scope, time, and cost constraints
Operational execution of project plans aligned to information management requirements
approvals: Internal milestone schedules driving BIM production
Resource allocation for BIM coordination and authoring
inputs: Project BEP, MIDP, and TIDPs from Project BIM Manager
Resource availability and discipline task commitments
Coordination risk logs from Project BIM Coordinator
